_note: Ross Towing palette and type. Red, steel and black are sampled from the Ross Towing logo (sent by Jennifer Gatt, Nov 3 2026). The same values are the CSS custom properties at the top of index.html. Contrast ratios are against the background named in 'use'.

red.use: Brand red from the logo truck and ROSS lettering. Call buttons, cash only banner, accents. White text on it is 6.1:1

redText.use: Red text and icons on light sections (6.4:1 on paper)

redOnDark.use: Red text, eyebrows and icons on dark sections (5.1:1 on asphalt, 4.7:1 on the spill section)

steel.use: Logo chrome and silver grey. Truck chrome in the illustrations

steelDeep.use: Darker steel for outlines in illustrations

asphalt.use: Main dark background (night sections), matches the logo badge black

signal.use: Amber warning light bar, hazards and rating stars only; never text

placeholder.use: Background of [PLACEHOLDER] tags so unconfirmed facts are impossible to miss

display.use: Headlines, phone number, signs, big figures

type.files: Self-hosted latin subsets in fonts/ (SIL Open Font License)

logo.files: img/logo-120|240|360 in AVIF, WebP and PNG (transparent, trimmed)
logo.source: Extracted from ROSS TOWING LOGO.docx (word/media/image1.png, 500x333). Raster illustration with gradients and chrome, so it is not traced to SVG; ask for the original vector file.
